name: io.github.drew-dot-com/charter
title: Charter: rent a machine by the hour
description: Agents rent a sandbox, a page fetcher or a Linux home by the hour. USDC on Base, x402, no account.

environmentVariables.name: CHARTER_MAX_USDC_PER_HOUR
environmentVariables.description: The most one interval may cost, in USDC. A dearer price is never signed.

environmentVariables.name: CHARTER_MAX_USDC_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: The most one UTC day may cost, in USDC.

environmentVariables.name: CHARTER_MCP_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: The wallet key file. Made on first run when absent. Default ~/.charter/mcp.key.

environmentVariables.name: CHARTER_MCP_NO_NEW_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set to never make a key: with no key file only the free tools answer.
